join_contract.runner_context_to_runner_marginals: one-to-one unique api_record_id; exact 17412/17412 keys and race_id parity
join_contract.runner_context_to_features: one-to-one on target api_record_id; race_id/date parity; only target subset is required
join_contract.race_context: one row per race_id, requiring one constant moisture and band per race
join_contract.actual_top3: finish_position <= 3 from the saved feature parquet; exactly 3 runners per target race

fixed_definitions.race_roster_aggregation: within each race compute mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0) over observed runners for body_kg, carried_weight_kg, and per-runner carried_weight_kg/body_kg; record nonmissing count and missing fraction for each
fixed_definitions.outcome_summary_unit: race-level vectors; one race contributes once, never one independent observation per runner
fixed_definitions.paired_date_interval: 2,000 cluster bootstrap draws, resample race_date clusters with replacement and retain all subgroup races per sampled date; numpy default_rng seed 20261008; pointwise 2.5/97.5 percentiles
fixed_definitions.lifetime_history: same_starts and same_valid_times are lifetime same-distance counts; they are distinct from bounded latest-five-slot same_distance_last5_actual_n and same_distance_last5_normal_n
fixed_definitions.ratio: per-runner carried_weight_kg divided by body_kg, then summarized by race mean and population SD

prohibited: model fitting, score/threshold/coefficient changes, production changes, database/network reads
joining by horse number, name, or jockey id
claiming same-event context is verified prediction-time data
zero-filling missing context or treating runners as independent race-level replicates
using outcome-defined groups to choose bands, thresholds, or deployable rules
